elements.element: Mutual cap applying to each party's aggregate liability
elements.evidence: "the total aggregate liability of each Party to the other Parties arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "(a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim by that Party under this Agreement"

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000, on a greater-of basis
elements.evidence: "the greater of ... (b) one million US dollars (US$1,000,000)"
21.3 "Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable to any other Party ... for any indirect or consequential loss or damage"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
elements.evidence: "a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations

elements.evidence: "a Party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "a Party's infringement of another Party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "All amounts due under this Agreement, including Customer's payment obligations, are not \"damages\""

elements.element: Mutual cap of 12 months' fees (fallback formulation)
elements.evidence: cap is "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim ... and (b) one million US dollars", not a cap equal to 12 months' fees

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "indemnification obligations ... confidentiality, data protection or security obligations ... gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud"

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are satisfied: a mutual greater-of cap (12 months' fees paid or payable preceding the claim / US$1,000,000), the pre-existing mutual indirect and consequential loss exclusion in 21.3, the full uncapped carve-out set (indemnification, confidentiality, data protection, security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and the payment-obligations-are-not-damages statement.
The fallback as literally worded (a cap of 12 months' fees) is not met by a greater-of cap, but that is immaterial because the locked target is the preferred level and it is satisfied.

Minimality holds: the clause set had no cap at all, so a single concise inserted subparagraph is the least intrusive fix; no untouched sentence was rewritten and no new exception favouring the counterparty was created.

Drafting note (not a deviation): "Customer's payment obligations" uses an alias not defined in this multi-party consortium agreement; the illustrative wording "All amounts due under this Agreement" carries the operative effect, but aligning the reference to "a Party's payment obligations" would remove any ambiguity.
